meta.title: Investigate ai prompt caching issue
meta.body_summary: Refactor chat API to move the static system prompt from the `system` parameter to a message with Anthropic `cacheControl` tag, enabling prompt caching and reducing token usage.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor enabled Anthropic prompt caching by moving static system prompt to message array with cacheControl tag; self-merged by maintainer with no review or performance numbers.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 29 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, self-contained optimization that merged immediately without review, consistent with a low-risk enablement change.

review_details.performance_claim: Enable Anthropic prompt caching for the static system prompt to reduce token-related cost/latency via cache hits.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Enabling a cloud API caching feature required understanding the specific SDK message format and Anthropic's caching constraints; Cursor could implement it successfully.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after measurements or cache-hit metrics; only narrative description of caching behavior. Verification would rely on observing `cacheReadInputTokens` in Anthropic usage metadata after deployment.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No review regression; merged immediately within seconds.

core_change_summary.description: In api/chat.ts, converted staticSystemPrompt from a system parameter to an explicit system message object with Anthropic cacheControl tag, reordered enrichedMessages so that the static system message appears first, ensuring the large static prompt is cacheable.
change_trajectory: Single commit (32d5401): Refactored chat API to improve system message handling and caching.
